judge.reader: the teammate assigned to review the PR, and the engineer who runs git blame on the retry code next year
questions: Does it say why the change is needed (duplicate claims, issue #311) before or alongside what changed?
Does it describe the behavior and the decisions (same key on every retry, which statuses retry, the backoff) rather than listing files?
Is its length right for this change: short enough to read before the diff, long enough to carry the risks a reviewer needs?
